title: A0 Camera Stitcher StitchJob manifest
description: The single durable commit point for a StitchJob (docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-0025 follow-up decision on GitHub Issue #39, implemented by Issue #40). A StitchJob is terminal-success only once this manifest has been published non-replacingly and re-read successfully. An output file existing on disk proves nothing on its own: a manifest that is missing, partial, schema-mismatched or hash-mismatched means the job did not succeed, and pre-v1 artifacts are refused rather than migrated. Absolute paths, serials, real identifiers and preview data are deliberately absent -- the output is named relative to the job directory so a manifest can be moved, read and verified without carrying anything about the machine that produced it.

stitchJobId.description: Immutable identity of this stitch attempt. A restitch is a new StitchJob with a new ID and its own manifest; a terminal manifest is never rewritten.

captureTransactionId.description: The CaptureTransaction whose retained originals this job consumed.

inputs.description: The two canonical originals, in rig order. Ordered rather than keyed by alias so a manifest cannot be read as if CAM-A and CAM-B were interchangeable.

engine.description: What produced the output. Two manifests with identical inputs and profile but different engines are different results, and nothing may treat them as interchangeable.

relativePath.description: Relative to the job directory. Absolute paths are excluded on purpose: they would tie a manifest to one machine and leak its layout.

terminalResultState.description: Only Succeeded is ever written. A failed job leaves no manifest at all, which is what makes 'manifest present and verified' the same statement as 'the job succeeded'.

automaticRetryCount.description: Fixed at zero across the product. Present so a reader can see it rather than having to know it.
